purpose: Checklist for human admission decisions. It consolidates version contracts, single-factor evidence, combination evidence, and required monitoring. It does not approve admission.

Retain every listed monitoring requirement after admission.

Do not admit to reach a target factor count; factor quality gates are unchanged.
